problems.title: Roots-of-unity hypothesis does not imply criterion

check.independent_reasoning: K=R has finitely many roots of unity and G_K=C2, so every orbit is locally finite. The infinite p-adic character of Zhat is regular yet cannot factor through Ga times the profinite algebraic factor as claimed. Number fields have infinite cyclotomic image and are not counterexamples to the main theorem.

problems.title: Faithful representation need not generate regular in one power
problems.impact: The actual W_i conditions impose faithfulness and bounded dimension but do not retain a trivial line. The sign representation satisfies them and has no tensor power containing the regular representation. The invalid step supplies Lemma 5.1, then finite-extension descent in Corollary 5.2 and the dimension-zero base case of Theorem 1.2. Major core proof defect; corrected permutation construction can repair it without disproving the Artin conclusion.

check.independent_reasoning: Root read the exact p12 representation choices: only faithfulness, subrepresentation status and dimension bound are required. The C2 sign representation meets them while every tensor power has dimension1, excluding its regular representation. Lemma5.1 supplies both Cor5.2 descent and the main theorem's dimension-zero base. A retained constant line/permutation argument repairs the core step; kernel containment earlier remains a proof obligation, not a separate all-geometric-hypothesis counterexample.
